memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Be careful not to neglect the Levites as long as you live in your land. When the Lord your God has enlarged your territory as he promised you, and you crave meat and say, "I would like some meat," then you may eat as much of it as you want. If the place where the Lord your God chooses to put his Name is too far away from you, you may slaughter animals from the herds and flocks the Lord has given you, as I have commanded you, and in your own towns you may eat as much of them as you want. - Deut 12:19-21 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Tucked into these instructions is a tender reminder: "Be careful not to neglect the Levites." The Levites had no land of their own, no fields to farm or inheritance to live on, because they were set apart to serve God and the people. Their provision depended on the generosity of the other tribes. So God pointedly reminds His people not to forget them. As Israel enjoyed God's blessing and expanded prosperity, they were to make sure those who served God's house were cared for.

There is a principle here that runs through Scripture: God's people are to provide for those who devote themselves to His service. It is easy, in the busyness of our own lives and the enjoyment of our own blessings, to overlook those who labor for the Lord and His people — pastors, ministers, missionaries, and others who serve. God calls us to be intentionally mindful of them, not to leave their care to chance.

The New Testament echoes this same concern. Paul teaches that "the worker deserves his wages" and that those who preach the gospel should be supported (1 Tim 5:17-18). Caring for God's servants is not optional generosity but a reflection of a grateful, well-ordered heart. As you enjoy God's blessings, remember those who labor in ministry, and look for ways to support and encourage them. In caring for God's servants, we honor God Himself. Who serves the Lord in your life, and how might you bless and support them today?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Am I mindful of those who devote themselves to serving God and His people?
- Do I look for ways to support and encourage ministers and gospel workers?
- Who serves the Lord in my life that I could bless today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, help me not to neglect those who serve You and Your people. As I enjoy Your blessings, make me generous and thoughtful toward pastors, missionaries, and all who labor for the gospel. Show me how to support and encourage them, honoring You in caring for them. Amen.
